rules.marks: reserved-code panels >= cutoff on every cell
rules.paired: reserved minus training-pool >= -13/512 on every cell; a two-sided WARNING at |difference| > 13 is not a mark
rules.control: >= 2/3 control seeds must meet the same ten cutoffs, else VOID ("recipe did not reproduce")
rules.arm_L: DESCRIPTIVE: no verdict depends on it
rules.invalid: any arm-F run whose frozen buffer moved, or any run that is not a full registered run (run_integrity)
rules.integrity: each scored run must have its arm-specific registered update count (10,000; F6 6,000), no overrides, the registered source fingerprint, declared LR at every logged row, frozen F/F6 scale 1.2, and matching F/F6 update-4000 fingerprints per seed
rules.pass_with_gap: STRUCK: no PASS-WITH-GAP tier; cutoffs_met_paired_missed is descriptive only
